alt: A short film with no voice, made for Stories. A pink dining room with a long dark table and three chairs. An ink-black block figure on the left leans in and slides a plate with one slice of dessert across the table to a cobalt blue figure on the right, whose eyes go happy. The third chair stays empty. The text stays on screen: if someone sent you this, save them a seat and a slice.
